author: dabfish
body: Hi,  My minecraft account username is BlameYourGPU and I would like to get unbanned from Wallsmc.com . Iv'e been banned for an unfortunate amount of 4 months. At the time of my false infraction i was accused of Hacking-Aimbot. While i still disagree with the current accusation I further believe i was not breaking any rules of the Avicus network. I request to be unbanned from the Avicus Network because in the time that iv'e been playing i have come to know friends achieved achievements such a Prestige and overall a completely extremely enjoyed the Avicus experience. Thank You.
